@element_prop_update.@bbox_padding_top<desc>: Defines the search range (in points) ABOVE the element when Step 5 is active. Useful for finding headers or titles.
@element_prop_update.@destination<desc>: Step 6: Check Link Destination. If true and the element is a Link Annotation, the property value is derived from the link's target URL or destination.
@element_prop_update.@text<desc>: Step 7: Hardcoded Text. If no value was found in Steps 1-6, this specific text string is applied as the final fallback.
@element_prop_update.@text<use>: To enforce a specific static text (e.g. 'Company Logo') regardless of other content, you must set this value AND set all previous steps (mc, children, prev, next, bbox_padding, destination) to false.

template.@artifact_update<desc>: Runs while post-processing the artifact candidate list: the template can keep an item as artifact (artifact true) or clear the artifact flag so the element moves back to header, footer, page body, or its initial-element parent.
template.@artifact_update<use>: Recover real content misclassified as decorative, or force keep-as-artifact when heuristics would promote an image back into the layout.

@artifact_update.@artifact<desc>: If false on a matching rule, the artifact classification is cleared and the element is removed from the artifact list and reinserted into layout containers. If true, the item stays an artifact.

template.@label_update<desc>: Refine words or elements already marked as list markers (label levels, patterns) before lists are assembled.
template.@label_update<use>: Runs late in the labeling pass, immediately before list_detect builds nested list structure; use it to correct marker levels or template-driven label assignments.
template.@list_update<desc>: After list_detect builds pde_list containers, refine each list: set flag (e.g. continuous), numbering style, or split back to plain texts.
template.@list_update<use>: Runs on nested list branches; use split on the main branch to dismantle a bad list while preserving item labels, or set numbering for consistent output style.

@list_update.@split<desc>: If set to true, splits the list back into individual elements. The label flag remains on each list item.

template.@tag_image<desc>: Runs while emitting structure for a pde_image: supplies Alt / ActualText, optional artifact escape hatch, and (PDF 2.0+) whether child widgets or annotations live under the Figure.
template.@tag_image<use>: Match images to set alt/actual_text from KB; set artifact true only when both are empty and the image is decorative; enable children only on PDF 2.0 when inline controls must stay inside the figure subtree.

@tag_image.@artifact<desc>: If true and both Alt and ActualText are empty after KB, the image is tagged as an artifact instead of a Figure. If false, a Figure with empty alt/actual may still be emitted (not PDF/UA compliant).
@tag_image.@children<desc>: PDF 2.0+: if true, nested children (text, form fields, annotations) are tagged under the Figure; if false, they are emitted beside the figure or as artifacts per engine defaults.

template.@tag_table<desc>: Emits Table structure for a pde_table: borders/isolated chrome as artifacts, optional split into per-cell traversal when headers are missing, and continuous tables that reuse one Table node across pages when the element continuous flag is set.
template.@tag_table<use>: Use split+row/col only for headerless tables that must still be read cell-by-cell; set summary for AT; rely on cell_update for TH scope before tagging when possible.

@tag_table.@split<desc>: When true flatten table to individual cells in row or column order.
@tag_table.@row<desc>: Used when split is true. When true, splits by table rows (default) when flattening. When false, splits by columns.
@tag_table.@summary<desc>: Set Table Summary attribute (owner Table) for assistive technologies.

template.@tag_update<desc>: Template hook on an existing pds_struct_elem during tagging commands: lets regex or programmatic filters accept or reject structure nodes by running KB rules against the live struct element.
template.@tag_update<use>: Used when tagging or content actions run template-based filters instead of a plain type regex; return a match to include the node in the processed set.
template.@annot_update<desc>: Runs when associating structure with a pdf_annot: adjust alt and Contents (and linked schema values) after the annotation is tied to content.
template.@annot_update<use>: Normalize link or markup annotations for accessibility text; pair with annot_char_overlap in pagemap for geometry-based character association.

@schema.statement<desc>: Controls conditional evaluation: $if / $elif / $else branches decide which template nodes run against the current query.
@schema.statement<use>: Can be used in all template functions. Evaluation stops when a branch matches ($if) or falls through ($elif/$else). If omitted, the default is $if.

statement.$if<desc>: Primary branch: the following query is evaluated when no earlier branch matched.
statement.$elif<desc>: Secondary branch evaluated only if previous $if/$elif queries did not match.
statement.$else<desc>: Fallback branch when no $if or $elif matched.

@schema.query<desc>: Predicate and context for a template node: parameters, logical operators, and optional variables that must pass before values are applied.

query.param<desc>: Define the number and type of input parameters.

param.pds_object_params<desc>: A parameter that represents PdsObject. The value starts with the character $, followed by a number (e.g., $0_width). The number represents the index of the parameter in the param array.
param.pde_element_params<desc>: A parameter that represents PdeElement. The value starts with the character $, followed by a number (e.g., $0_width). The number represents the index of the parameter in the param array.
param.pds_struct_elem_params<desc>: A parameter that represents a structure-tree element. The value starts with the character $, followed by a number (e.g., $0_width). The number represents the index of the parameter in the param array.
param.pdf_annot_params<desc>: A parameter that represents a PDF annotation. The value starts with the character $, followed by a number (e.g., $0_width). The number represents the index of the parameter in the param array.
param.int<desc>: Integer operand in a condition (no fractional part).
param.bool<desc>: Boolean true/false operand in a condition.

query.var<desc>: User-defined variables; reference bbox macros such as left, width, or top in conditions.

@schema.logical_operators<desc>: Combine multiple query conditions: $and requires all branches, $or any branch, $not inverts one branch.
@schema.logical_operators<use>: Nest under query to build compound predicates on bbox, text, or parameter fields.

logical_operators.$and<desc>: Logical AND. All sub-conditions must be true.
logical_operators.$or<desc>: Logical OR. At least one sub-condition must be true.

@schema.comparison_operators<desc>: Scalar comparisons ($eq, $ne, $lt, …), regex match ($regex), and bbox containment ($in / $nin).
@schema.comparison_operators<use>: Combine under logical_operators inside query.$and / $or to filter template matches.

comparison_operators.$eq<desc>: Field equals the given literal (string, number, or bool).
comparison_operators.$eq<use>: Exact match on name, tag_type, flag string, or numeric geometry.
comparison_operators.$ne<desc>: Field differs from the given literal.
comparison_operators.$ne<use>: Exclude a specific tag type or marker level from a broad rule.
comparison_operators.$lt<desc>: Numeric field strictly less than the operand.
comparison_operators.$lt<use>: Upper-bound font size, width, or column index comparisons.
comparison_operators.$lte<desc>: Numeric field less than or equal to the operand.
comparison_operators.$lte<use>: Inclusive limits for spacing or table geometry.
comparison_operators.$gt<desc>: Numeric field strictly greater than the operand.
comparison_operators.$gte<desc>: Numeric field greater than or equal to the operand.
comparison_operators.$gte<use>: Minimum inclusive thresholds for area or font metrics.
comparison_operators.$regex<desc>: String field must match the given regular expression pattern.
comparison_operators.$regex<use>: Use on text, name, or tag fields; escape special characters per engine rules.
comparison_operators.$in<desc>: True when the parameter’s bbox lies inside the comparison bbox (spatial containment).
comparison_operators.$in<use>: Typical for hit-testing a region against an anchor or column band.
comparison_operators.$nin<desc>: True when the parameter’s bbox does not lie inside the comparison bbox.
comparison_operators.$nin<use>: Exclude elements whose geometry falls inside a masked region.

@schema.pds_object_params<desc>: Catalog of low-level PDF content object shapes (pds_text, pds_path, …) usable as QUERY param types for object_update.

pds_object.type<desc>: Concrete pds_* subtype for this object instance.

@schema.pds_struct_elem_params<desc>: Structure-tree element parameters for tag_update and similar hooks (pds_struct_elem).

pds_struct_elem.type<desc>: Structure element role/type name as in the PDF structure tree.
pds_struct_elem.is_standard_tag<desc>: A value identifying whether the tag is a standard tag for detected PDF.

@schema.pdf_annot_params<desc>: Annotation fields available when pdf_annot is a query parameter (annot_update, linking).

pdf_annot.type<desc>: Annotation subtype (link, text, highlight, …) exposed to the template.

@schema.pde_element_params<desc>: Layout element field catalog (pde_text, pde_image, …) referenced from QUERY param arrays.

pde_table.isolated_num<desc>: Number of isolated elements in the table.

@schema.general_vars<desc>: Built-in read-only variables ($page_*, $doc_*) usable in query conditions without declaring parameters.
@schema.general_vars<use>: Compare geometry or typography against page averages, or gate rules on anchor names already resolved for the page or document.

general_vars.$page_num<desc>: 1-based index of the page being processed.
general_vars.$page_num<use>: First-page-only or last-page rules when combined with $doc_num_pages.
general_vars.$page_width<desc>: Crop box width in default user space units (same basis as layout bboxes).
general_vars.$page_width<use>: Normalize element widths (e.g. $0_width / $page_width) or margin rules.
general_vars.$page_height<desc>: Crop box height in default user space units (same basis as layout bboxes).
general_vars.$page_height<use>: Header/footer band tests as a fraction of $page_height.
general_vars.$page_font_size<desc>: Dominant body font size estimated for the page.
general_vars.$page_font_size<use>: Scale distance thresholds that are stored as font multiples in pagemap.
general_vars.$page_min_font_size<desc>: Smallest font size observed on the page.
general_vars.$page_min_font_size<use>: Catch footnotes or legal lines that must be treated differently from body text.
general_vars.$page_max_font_size<desc>: Largest font size observed on the page.
general_vars.$page_max_font_size<use>: Identify display headings or cover titles by size alone.
general_vars.$page_rotation<desc>: PDF /Rotate value in degrees for the page (typically 0, 90, 180, or 270).
general_vars.$page_rotation<use>: Branch rules for landscape vs portrait or skip geometry heuristics that assume rotation 0.
general_vars.$page_rtl<desc>: True when the page is treated as right-to-left for layout. Set during page-content parsing when the knowledge base enables RTL handling and a text object contains a character classified as right-to-left; if RTL is disabled in the knowledge base, this flag is usually not set that way and stays false.
general_vars.$page_rtl<use>: Branch template rules on page RTL state; pair with KB/settings RTL if you rely on parse-time detection rather than document-wide defaults alone.
general_vars.$page_anchor<desc>: Comma-joined names of anchors already registered on this page during template application.
general_vars.$page_anchor<use>: Test substring or regex membership to skip duplicate rules or target follow-up logic after an anchor fired.
general_vars.$doc_num_pages<desc>: Total page count in the PDF document.
general_vars.$doc_num_pages<use>: Enable rules only on single-page vs multi-page jobs.
general_vars.$doc_lang<desc>: Document-level language hint from metadata or detection.
general_vars.$doc_lang<use>: Pick regex tables or tag defaults when the pack is bilingual.
general_vars.$doc_title<desc>: Title string from document metadata when available.
general_vars.$doc_title<use>: Match cover or running metadata in rare conditional templates.
general_vars.$doc_anchor<desc>: Comma-joined anchor names resolved anywhere in the document so far.
general_vars.$doc_anchor<use>: Apply doc-wide follow-up rules only after a named anchor (e.g. title block) was seen.

@schema.values<desc>: Reusable field definitions (alt, flag, bbox, …) linked from template nodes via schema:values:*.
@schema.values<use>: Each entry documents type, meaning, and allowed flag or enum strings for queries and *_update payloads.

values.type<desc>: Discriminator string for the object or element in a query param slot.
values.alt<desc>: Alternate description for figures, images, and other structure elements (PDF/UA).
values.alt<use>: Required for meaningful Figure tags; can be filled by element_prop_update if omitted in the PDF.
values.actual_text<desc>: Replacement Unicode string for structure or content when true text is not encoded as glyphs (or for accessibility overrides).
values.actual_text<use>: Set on images, artifacts, or ligature-heavy lines where Alt alone is insufficient.
values.expansion<desc>: Spoken or spelled-out form of an abbreviation or acronym (E for expanded form in tagged PDF).
values.expansion<use>: Pair with short headings or metrics in body text so assistive tech can read the long form once.
values.lang<desc>: BCP 47 / ISO language tag applied to the element (e.g. en-US).
values.lang<use>: Set on text containers for screen-reader language switching.
values.id<desc>: Stable structure-element identifier string carried into the tag tree when set from the template.
values.id<use>: Correlate output with external CMS rows or cross-reference captions and figures.
values.associated_header<desc>: Header cell id(s) this data cell relates to; use | to list multiple associations.
values.associated_header<use>: PDF/UA: link TD cells to TH ids when automatic scope detection is ambiguous.
values.has_content<desc>: True when the structure node has real page-marked content (text, paths, images) under it in the tag tree—not counting OBJR-only annotation references.
values.has_content<use>: Distinguish empty wrapper tags from leaf nodes with MCID-backed content.
values.has_annot<desc>: True when the structure element references annotations via OBJR entries (links, widgets, markup) even if no direct text path is attached.
values.has_annot<use>: Target Link or Form structure without relying on has_content alone.
values.tag_type<desc>: PDF structure type name or regex (e.g. Figure, P, .*).
values.tag_type<use>: Filter tag_update or tagging pipelines to specific roles.
values.parent_tag_type<desc>: Same vocabulary as tag_type: role name or regex for the parent structure node in tag_update queries.
values.parent_tag_type<use>: Match only when the immediate ancestor is e.g. Link, Table, or Sect.
values.children_tag_type<desc>: Same vocabulary as tag_type: role name or regex tested against child structure types.
values.children_tag_type<use>: Require that a container already wraps specific child roles before running a rule.
values.annot_type<desc>: PDF annotation subtype name (Link, Widget, Highlight, …) or regex; use .* to match all.
values.annot_type<use>: Narrow annot_update or tagging rules to links vs form fields vs markup.
values.contents<desc>: Human-readable string written to the annotation Contents entry, or TU for widget tooltips when mapping to accessibility.
values.contents<use>: Set via annot_update when the PDF lacks a proper tooltip or link description.
values.annot_flag<desc>: Comma-separated list of PDF annotation flag keywords (invisible, print, read_only, …). The token contents refers to the flag bit, not this string property.
values.annot_flag<use>: Filter out hidden or no-view annotations, or select print-only stamps.
values.title<desc>: Human-readable title string on annotations or widgets when exposed by the PDF.
values.name<desc>: Template element `name` for this element (letters, digits, hyphen; no $ or _).
values.name<use>: Referenced by parent, variables like $NAME_left, and single_instance deduplication keys.
values.parent<desc>: Optional parent override by element `name`; changes default element nesting.
values.parent<use>: Use when you need to re-parent an element and that parenting was not already defined by the initial-element tree.
values.caption<desc>: Element `name` of an element that should be attached as this element's caption/title child.
values.caption<use>: Set when a specific element must be inserted during tagging as the first child (caption-first/title behavior).
values.angle<desc>: Rotation of the text or element in radians (positive = counter-clockwise in user space).
values.bbox<desc>: Axis-aligned bounds in default user space: left, bottom, right, top. Coordinates may be literals, $page_* macros, anchor offsets, or simple math. One bbox ties to one anchor for variable expansion.
values.cell_column<desc>: The specific column index (1-based) of the cell within the table.
values.cell_column<use>: Use this in queries to target specific columns. For example, to mark all cells in column 1 as row headers.
values.cell_row<desc>: The specific row index (1-based) of the cell within the table.
values.cell_row<use>: Use this in queries to target specific rows. For example, 'If cell_row is 1, set as Header'.
values.cell_row_span<desc>: The number of vertical rows this cell merges or covers.
values.cell_row_span<use>: Important for complex tables. Use to identify or set cells that cover multiple data points vertically.
values.cell_column_span<desc>: The number of horizontal columns this cell merges or covers.
values.cell_column_span<use>: Commonly used for top-level headers that group multiple sub-columns (e.g., 'Q1 Results' spanning 'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar').
values.cell_scope<desc>: Defines the accessibility scope of a header cell (Row, Column, or Both).
values.cell_scope<use>: Crucial for PDF/UA compliance. Set to 'Column' for top headers and 'Row' for side headers so screen readers associate data correctly.
values.col_num<desc>: Logical column count of the parent pde_table after recognition (grid width, not visual guides).
values.col_num<use>: Target narrow vs wide tables (e.g. only style two-column grids) or skip rules on single-column layouts.
values.children_num<desc>: Direct child count: layout children for pde_*, or tag-tree children including OBJR for structure nodes.
values.children_num<use>: Detect empty wrappers vs populated containers; trim leaf tags with zero children in tag_update.
values.object_num<desc>: Number of low-level PDF objects (paths, text runs, images) merged into this layout element.
values.object_num<use>: Heuristics for widgets (e.g. checkbox: one path empty, multiple paths when checked) or icon complexity.
values.artifact<desc>: Indicates if the page content object is explicitly marked as an Artifact via a Marked Content Sequence (BMC/BDC tag with /Artifact property).
values.artifact<use>: Use to filter out content that is already defined as background/decorative at the PDF syntax level. If true, the object should typically be ignored by layout analysis.
values.mcid<desc>: The Marked Content Identifier (MCID) assigned to this content stream object.
values.mcid<use>: Crucial for Tagged PDF (PDF/UA). A value >= 0 links the content to the tag tree. A value of -1 indicates the content is untagged or not properly associated.
values.has_fill<desc>: Indicates whether the object has a fill color applied.
values.has_fill<use>: Use as a safeguard before checking 'fill_color'. Ensures you are evaluating color only on objects that actually have a fill, preventing logical errors on transparent or unfilled shapes.
values.fill_color<desc>: The RGB components of the object's fill (interior) color.
values.fill_color<use>: Color-based detection (e.g. shaded table headers). Prefer checking has_fill first unless the content model guarantees a fill.
values.has_stroke<desc>: Indicates whether the object has a stroke (border/outline) applied.
values.has_stroke<use>: Use as a safeguard before checking 'stroke_color'. Ensures you are evaluating color only on objects that actually have a stroke, avoiding errors on borderless shapes.
values.stroke_color<desc>: The RGB components of the object's stroke (border) color.
values.stroke_color<use>: Defines the target border color values. Best practice is to evaluate this only when 'has_stroke' is true, or when you are certain the object possesses a stroke.
values.fill_alpha<desc>: The opacity level of the fill color, ranging from 0 (invisible) to 255 (fully opaque).
values.fill_alpha<use>: Use to detect semi-transparent elements like watermarks or highlights (e.g., if fill_alpha < 255, mark as Artifact).
values.stroke_alpha<desc>: The opacity level of the stroke color, ranging from 0 (invisible) to 255 (fully opaque).
values.stroke_alpha<use>: Use to detect faint or transparent lines that should be ignored or treated as background decoration.
values.has_transparency<desc>: Indicates if the element or object contains any transparency features.
values.has_transparency<use>: Primarily used to detect Form XObjects that contain transparency. This helps determine if an XObject can be safely flattened or must be preserved to maintain correct visual rendering.
values.flag<desc>: Template-driven behavior on an element: for example no_join and no_split control merging; continuous keeps one structure tag across pages for tables, lists, or text when tagging; splitter ends continuous chains for the types listed in splitter; artifact, header, and footer move content out of the main reading flow.
values.flag<use>: Combine with splitter type list to end multi-page tables; use continuous only when tag output must span pages without a new Table/L root.
values.numbering<desc>: List numbering style for the element (None, Unordered, Decimal, UpperRoman, LowerRoman, and other schema values). Drives list attributes and ordered-marker continuation when ordinals are detected.
values.numbering<use>: Force Decimal vs Unordered on list_update, or normalize markers that were misclassified.
values.single_instance<desc>: Pipe-separated property keys; duplicates sharing those keys collapse so only the first instance is kept for tagging or layout.
values.single_instance<use>: Dedupe repeated logos, headers, or boilerplate that share font, bbox, or text.
values.word_space<desc>: When word_update matches and sets this float, the engine stores it as that font’s fixed space width before lines are built, so later layout uses that spacing for the font.
values.word_space<use>: Set on a representative word so the whole font’s spacing shifts; pagemap word_space_ratio still multiplies those KB-locked widths afterward.
values.font_name<desc>: PDF font base name for the text object or run.
values.font_size<desc>: Font size in points (text height scale) for the object or run.
values.red<desc>: The red component of an RGB color.
values.green<desc>: The green component of an RGB color.
values.blue<desc>: The blue component of an RGB color.
values.cell_header<desc>: True when this table cell should be emitted or treated as a header (TH) for accessibility.
values.cell_header<use>: Set from cell_update when detection missed a shaded header row, or clear false for false positives.
values.cell_associated_header<desc>: Pipe-separated list of header cell ids associated with this cell (see associated_header).
values.cell_associated_header<use>: Mirrors associated_header at cell scope for complex TH/TD relationships in cell_update.
values.heading<desc>: Logical heading level for structure output (normal, h1–h6, h, note, title).
values.heading<use>: Map visual styles to PDF/UA heading roles without relying on font size alone.
values.width<desc>: Width of the bbox in default user space units (points).
values.width<use>: Compare to page width for full-bleed blocks, or scale thresholds with $page_width.
values.height<desc>: Height of the bbox in default user space units (points).
values.height<use>: Detect thin separator lines vs tall text blocks using height ratios.
values.label<desc>: List-marker classification: label_no (not a marker), label (generic), label_list (list body), or li_1–li_6 for outline depth used by list_detect.
values.label<use>: On an initial pde_list, pinning fixes the level for every item; elsewhere use label_update to correct mis-leveled markers before list_detect.
values.label_text<desc>: String or regex for the visible marker token (digits, bullets, roman numerals) consistent with pagemap_regex numbering and bullet patterns.
values.label_text<use>: Pin on initial pde_list so every item shares one marker pattern; or narrow list_update to custom bullet glyphs not in default regex tables.
values.left<desc>: Left edge x of the bbox in default user space.
values.left<use>: Compare to $page_width or anchor left for column and margin rules.
values.right<desc>: Right edge x of the bbox in default user space.
values.right<use>: Test alignment to page margin or table width.
values.top<desc>: Top edge y of the bbox in default user space.
values.bottom<desc>: Bottom edge y of the bbox in default user space.
values.bottom<use>: Footer detection or minimum distance to page bottom.
values.baseline_x<desc>: Horizontal position of the text baseline origin for this text object.
values.baseline_x<use>: Align captions, rules, or anchors to typographic baseline instead of bbox edges.
values.baseline_y<desc>: Vertical position of the text baseline for this text object.
values.baseline_y<use>: Compare line positions or detect superscript offset relative to body lines.
values.pdf_rect<desc>: Rectangle in default user space as left, bottom, right, top (same meaning as bbox for query macros).
values.pdf_rgb<desc>: Device RGB triplet 0–255 per channel for comparisons against fill_color or stroke_color.
values.reflow<desc>: When false, hard line breaks in the PDF are preserved in logical text; when true, softer wrapping may be applied depending on export path.
values.reflow<use>: Disable reflow for poetry or code blocks where each line must stay separate.
values.row_num<desc>: Detected row count for the parent table element.
values.row_num<use>: Target rules at tables with a specific vertical extent (e.g. header-only grids).
values.table_type<desc>: Classifier label for how the table was formed: graphic (paths), isolated, row/column text layout, or form-derived.
values.table_type<use>: Branch template logic: e.g. stricter tag_table rules for graphic tables only.
values.text<desc>: Unicode string extracted for the object or tag: prefers marked-content text (MCID), then related annotation strings; length may be capped by max_char in tooling.
values.text<use>: Regex or equality tests on body copy, headers, or link visible text.
values.text_flag<desc>: Paragraph-level caption and line-break hints set from detection or template (table_caption, filling, …).
values.text_flag<use>: Route captions into tag roles or suppress paragraph merge across caption boundaries.
values.text_line_flag<desc>: Line-level layout hints: hyphenation, indent, terminal punctuation, drop cap, filling, etc.
values.text_line_flag<use>: Tune text_line_update or neighbours rules when line breaks carry semantic meaning.
values.text_state_flag<desc>: Graphics-state text attributes on a text run: underline, strikeout, highlight, sub/superscript, unicode hints.
values.text_state_flag<use>: Select runs for special tagging (e.g. underline as Link) in text_run_update.
values.word_flag<desc>: Word-level classification flag (hyphen, bullet, numbering family, etc.) aligned with pagemap_regex-driven markers.
values.word_flag<use>: Target word_update rules at bullets, ordinals, or page numbers without matching raw Unicode.

@schema.suffix<desc>: Meta-keys (<desc>, <type>, <link>, …) that annotate schema entries for editors and docs, not runtime JSON children.
@schema.suffix<rule>: A name suffix marks the preceding token as the real key; the suffix segment is documentation only and is not loaded as a child property.

suffix.<desc>: Human-readable explanation of the key or node.
suffix.<use>: Guidance for template authors (when to set the value, typical ranges).
suffix.<type>: JSON or UI type of the value (string, bool, int, …).
suffix.<types>: Allowed types when a node accepts more than one representation.
suffix.<value>: Enumeration of legal string tokens or literals for pickers.
suffix.<default>: Fallback value when the author omits the field.
suffix.<rule>: Extra constraints or interaction between sibling keys.
suffix.<num_values>: How many operands this operator or field expects.
suffix.<link>: Pointer to another schema path (schema:…) for shared definitions.
suffix.<insert>: Default tree-node payload used when inserting this schema shape in UI editors.

@schema.condition<desc>: How a field is compared: fixed value (condition_value), one operator object (comparison), or an array of operators (comparison_array).
@schema.condition<use>: Reference param indices like 0_width with $lt / $regex / $in under query logical groups.

condition.comparison<desc>: Example: {"0_width": {"$lt": 100}} — one comparison operator per field.
condition.comparison_array<desc>: Example: {"0_width": [{"$lt": 10}, {"$gt": 5}]} — multiple operator objects chained on the same indexed field.

@schema.keywords<desc>: Reserved template keywords: query, param, statement, disable, and related control fields shared by function nodes.

keywords.general<desc>: Metadata bucket (version, dates, id, SDK) at template root.
keywords.template<desc>: Root object that holds pagemap, element_create, *_update functions, and tagging hooks.
keywords.query<desc>: Present on every function node: declares which object types are evaluated and optional $and/$or condition trees.
keywords.param<desc>: Nested arrays of type names (e.g. pde_text, pde_table) aligned with the function’s insert signature.
keywords.statement<desc>: $if / $elif / $else on a function node: evaluation stops at the first matching branch with a passing query.
keywords.disable<desc>: If true, the entire function node is skipped. Default false.
keywords.purpose<desc>: Optional free-text note for authors; not interpreted by the engine.

@schema.insert<desc>: Factory snippets the schema UI uses when inserting new template fragments.
@schema.insert<use>: Not merged into runtime templates automatically; editors copy these shapes into element_create or cell grids.

insert.elements_add_value<desc>: Minimal pde_text initial element with zero bbox (replace with real coordinates).
insert.elements_add_cell<desc>: Starter pde_cell with unit span and default scope for table shells.

@schema.math_expressions<desc>: Built-in math helpers (SUM, MIN, MAX, …) for macro or variable definitions in advanced templates.
@schema.math_expressions<use>: Compose bbox or threshold expressions that reference multiple anchor variables.
